decisions.reason: The source requires the table of contents to use final page numbers but does not change the issue ordering basis, article placement, or pagination rules.

The table-of-contents correction does not change the article-ending whitespace standard or permitted balancing elements.
The requirement to use correct table-of-contents page numbers does not affect advertisement rendering quality.
The table-of-contents page-number correction does not change the article body-font requirement.
Correcting table-of-contents references does not add, remove, or otherwise change the content required in the issue.
The source decision does not change author-name, author-photo, sizing, shape, coverage, or source requirements.
Accurate table-of-contents pagination does not modify the magazine's visual style, branding reference, or color-use rules.
The source decision concerns table-of-contents references and does not change image-quality enhancement requirements.
The table-of-contents correction does not alter treatment of long article text or the use of text-break elements.
The source describes a correction needed before launch but does not change the established launch target or deadline.
